rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3BB blastocyst and correctly identifies a loosely grouped ICM and sparse TE, but some image-specific claims (blastocoel ~60-65%, granular cytoplasm, epithelial gaps) are somewhat overinterpreted from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometriosis, smoking, prior failed cycles, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis, though the quantitative probability adjustments are somewhat heuristic rather than rigorously derived.

Much of the advice is broadly evidence-based, but several recommendations (ERA/EMMA/ALICE, NK cell testing, HLA typing, routine thrombophilia/immunologic workup, strong PGT-A recommendation at age 31) go beyond or are not strongly supported by major IVF guidelines.

Provides clear next-step options for proceeding now versus freeze-all and outlines practical future workup and lifestyle optimization, though some suggested tests/interventions may be more aggressive than necessary.
